logline: Emerging from the smoke of the shattered cathedral gates in full ducal regalia, Alexander confronts Rupert, wins the loyalty of the royal guards, and is proclaimed the rightful Duke of Ashburn by his weeping mother.

moments.description: Alexander strides through the shattered cathedral gates in full ducal regalia, stunning the blond nobleman with his sudden return.
Rupert commands the royal guards to arrest Alexander, but the guards defiantly refuse to obey him.
The royal guard firmly declares loyalty to Alexander, shattering Rupert's control over the room.
moments.key_dialogue: Because we know who he is.

moments.description: Alexander reunites with his weeping mother amidst the ruins, gently receiving her loving touch.
moments.key_dialogue: Look at you... my beautiful boy.

moments.description: Alexander's mother publicly proclaims him the rightful Duke of Ashburn, leaving Rupert utterly defeated as Alexander vows vengeance.
moments.key_dialogue: And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole.
